theorem: For every finite generalized quadrangle of order (q,q), the apartment/theta Tanner graph has exactly T(q)(q-2) six-cycles.
root_lemma: Two apartments in a theta check share a length-four geodesic root.

Given A=R union R1 and B=R union R2, an apartment adjacent to both either is the theta companion R1 union R2 or also contains R; a different two-root pattern contradicts uniqueness of geodesics below distance four in a girth-eight GQ.
Therefore genuine Tanner six-cycles are exactly triples of apartments through one common root.
boundary: Pure Tanner/building combinatorics; no decoder threshold or physical-noise claim follows.
